[G] DiagramService
|-- RevisionedDiagramService is the sole content writer
|   |-- ~ create(input) -> DiagramRevisionEditor.prepareCreate -> issue
|   |-- ~ revise(baseRevisionId, edit) -> getRevision -> prepareEdit
|   `-- An unchanged edit returns the existing base revision
|-- Issued revisions use a shared registry
|   |-- ~ issue -> diagramRevisions.register({ id, diagramId, parentId?, diagram, nodeRefs })
|   |-- Node correspondence preserves prior node references where possible
|   |-- ~ getRevision -> registry.get; listRevisions -> frozen summaries
|   `-- Registry lifetime and reclamation are unspecified in these excerpts
`-- The optional generator is referenced; its ownership is unspecified
    |-- ~ generate(request, options) -> generator.generate(structuredClone(request), options)
    |-- Missing generators fail; abort is checked before and after generation
    |-- The base revision must belong to the requested local diagram ID
    `-- ~ generated input -> revise(base, replace) | create(revision: 0)
